verdict: MRVL +32% on Jensen Huang 'next trillion-dollar company' endorsement at GTC Taipei; DRAM Q1-2026 industry revenue +81% QoQ confirmed; CRDO blowout earnings +206% YoY; AVGO reports June 3 — broadly bullish semi/AI complex.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (Last 24–72h)

### Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing
TrendForce (published June 1): Q1-2026 DRAM industry revenue **+81% QoQ to $97B** — confirmed. Contract prices +93–98% QoQ. Q2-2026 outlook: conventional DRAM +58–63% QoQ (rate decelerating, absolute pricing still historically extreme). HBM contract prices now in YoY decline as DDR5 profitability closes the gap; DDR5 margins projected to surpass HBM3e starting Q1-2026. **Bull on conventional DRAM; watch HBM unit economics.**

### Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp / Correction Risk
No new correction signals. 2026 HBM supply across all three suppliers remains sold out. Micron executing early HBM4 ramp; SK Hynix Yongin cluster opens 2027; Samsung targeting 50% HBM capacity surge by end-2026. Baseline post-2026 correction-risk thesis **unchanged — no new confirmation or denial**.

### Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex
No fresh guide-downs. Aggregate 2026 capex for top-5 hyperscalers now tracking **~$750B** (revised above baseline $600–700B). Meta raised full-year capex to $125–145B citing higher component/DC costs. No deceleration signal anywhere in the stack.

### Signal 4 — AMD MI400/Helios + Custom ASIC
AMD MI400/Helios confirmed on track for H2-2026 (TSMC N2, HBM4). Meta unveiled **MTIA 400** (6 PFLOPS FP8, 288GB HBM, 9.2 Tbps, 1,200W). AWS Trainium4 targets late-2026/early-2027 (3× FP8 vs Trainium3). Custom silicon pipeline accelerating on schedule.

### Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics
CRDO Q4 FY2026 (reported June 1): revenue **$1.34B, +206% YoY**; FY2027 guide **>80% growth**, optical alone >$600M. Analyst PT hikes: Roth Capital $200→$300 Buy, Goldman $170→$250 Buy, JPMorgan $230→$250 OW. Rothschild initiated coverage on ALAB, CRDO, LITE, COHR, CIEN. Note: COHR −10%, LITE −7% in early May on sector-cooling narrative — CRDO's blowout argues the buildout is intact.

### Signal 6 — Solar
No fresh news today. FSLR hit an 18-year intraday high on May 28 (+10.8%) on Section 232 polysilicon tariff speculation — CdTe tech isolates FSLR from Chinese silicon exposure. Official Section 232 ruling reportedly overdue (end-of-May target passed). Watching for announcement.

---

## Watchlist Movers

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| **MRVL** | **+32%** (Jun 2) | Jensen Huang at GTC Taipei called Marvell **"the next trillion-dollar company"**; reiterated $2B NVIDIA strategic investment; framed as ecosystem play via NVLink Fusion. Biggest single-day gain in MRVL history. Market cap ~$250B at close. |
| **CRDO** | Strong (Jun 1–2) | Q4 FY2026: $1.34B revenue +206% YoY; FY2027 guide >80%; optical alone >$600M. PT hikes from GS/JPM/Roth. |
| **NVDA** | Positive (Jun 1–2) | GTC Taipei: Vera Rubin CPU enters mass production (fall 2026 shipments); Huang declared "useful AI has arrived." $0.25 dividend ex-date Jun 4. |
| **AVGO** | Pending (Jun 3 AMC) | Q2 FY2026 earnings after close Jun 3. AI revenue guide $10.7B (+140% YoY). Street wants 25% sequential beat/raise. Next live binary for the complex. |
| **FSLR** | +10.8% (May 28) | 18-year high on Section 232 polysilicon tariff expectations; CdTe advantage vs Chinese silicon peers. |

---

## Context vs. Baseline

- DRAM Q1 confirmed at +81% QoQ industry revenue — on the high end of baseline expectations; AI server demand-pull tracking above base case.
- MRVL $2B NVIDIA partnership + Jensen "trillion-dollar" endorsement is **exactly the watchlist event flagged as must-catch** — NVIDIA names a partner and the stock moves >5%.
- AVGO earnings June 3 are the next major binary; AI revenue guide was $10.7B — a beat/raise could lift the broader semi complex.
- HBM post-2026 correction-risk thesis **unchanged** — no new supply or pricing data to confirm or deny.
- Hyperscaler capex revised up to ~$750B aggregate; no first guide-down anywhere.

## Most Important Development

**MRVL +32% on Jensen Huang's GTC Taipei endorsement** is the single largest name-level catalyst of the session — the exact NVIDIA-names-watchlist-partner scenario this monitor is designed to catch. Secondary: **CRDO Q4 blowout** (+206% YoY, >80% FY2027 guide) independently confirms the optical/connectivity infrastructure buildout is real and accelerating. **AVGO June 3 earnings** are the next live binary for the entire AI semi complex.
